dataset.title: 27 years of livestock production data under different stocking rate levels at the Central Grasslands Research Extension Center near Streeter, North Dakota

interpretation: Rows are animal-season records; animals share pastures and management exposures.
Simple summaries are descriptive and are not treatment-effect estimates.
The source does not report individual dry matter intake or a confinement comparator.
One tag is duplicated within 1999 with conflicting record values; retain the source line ID and do not merge by year and tag alone.
